Member countries

We are a network of over 1,000 government officials from 22 countries, and benefit from the participation of experts, industry and members of civil society in our discussions. We welcome new member countries from emerging oil and gas provinces and value contributions from established producers.

New member countries

The New Producers for Sustainable Energy welcomes new member countries. Prospective and new oil and gas producers can join as members. And established producers can join as peer countries.

Become a memberMembers area
NP4SENew Producers for Sustainable Energy

NP4SE is a South-South group of 22 countries new to oil and gas, looking for a path to prosperity while protecting the environment.
